cues.text: Watch F1 Finance's machine test HANGS General Contracting's internal controls: the checks that stop mistakes and fraud.
It walks through eleven key controls.
Segregation of duties means one person shouldn't both set up a vendor and pay it. Here one person did both, for four payments of about $64,700.
Billing to cash works: every bill approved, every receipt posted on time.
Payrolls are reviewed before release, but the payroll manager's own raise had no signed approval.
Thirty large journal entries, over $8 million, had no second review. No bank reconciliation is signed as reviewed.
A significant deficiency is a weakness serious enough to report to those in charge. It proposes two.

All done. Four of eleven key controls work as designed. Two significant deficiencies and two smaller deficiencies are proposed. Seven items stay open. This is not an opinion on controls: the CPA, a person, decides every level and signs.
